data.one_liner: A collection of custom Flutter widgets and UI utilities created by GroovinChip.
data.what_it_does: Provides a library of reusable custom widgets such as ModalDrawerHandle, OutlineDropdownButton, GroovinExpansionTile, SplitColorBackground, and AvatarBackButton, along with utility functions for colors and JSON formatting.
use_when: You need a modal bottom sheet drawer handle quickly.
You want custom-styled dropdown buttons and form fields with outlines.
You are replicating split-color background screen layouts common in modern app designs.
avoid_when: You require an actively maintained official design system UI library.
You need platform-specific adaptive widgets rather than custom standalone elements.
strengths: Offers specific, hard-to-find UI components like modal drawer handles and split color backgrounds out of the box.
Includes helpful color and JSON formatting utilities.
weaknesses: Small utility package maintained by a single developer with potentially slow update cycles.
Lacks comprehensive widget documentation beyond basic properties.
